content:
alex_k: Heads-up — planning a 1-week partner sandbox / demo sprint with LangChain + LlamaIndex + a couple gateway vendors. Goal: reproducible demo app + marketplace listing checklist. Who's in?

maria_pm: in. timeline? dates?

alex_k: thinking Feb 7–14 (internal only), public demo in week after. need signoffs from eng + marketing + SI leads.

ben_eng: engineering can support but need clear acceptance tests. propose these minimal tests: embedding ingest, retrieval chain, tool-calls through gateway, and a cold-start latency run.

sophia_partner: partners want a stable sandbox URL + sample dataset. also single-click onboarding for LangChain agent flows.

jim_sre: will create ephemeral infra. need a precise resource matrix: GPUs, mem, expected concurrency. send me numbers and I'll provision.

alex_k: preliminary matrix: 2xA10, 8 vCPU app node, 32GB mem for demo. concurrency ~5. can we do autoscale?

jim_sre: autoscale yes but with strict caps. I'll set quotas.

integrations-bot: workspace created: `partner-sandbox-2101` — invite links posted to #partners. (token rotated)

maria_pm: marketing wants joint announcement assets ready by Feb 5. need logo guidelines, one-pager, and shared demo script. @marketing_anna can you coordinate?

marketing_anna: yep. will draft a short landing + demo script. also need partner logos and legal ok for co-marketing. Sophia — can you push assets?

sophia_partner: sending logos + one-sentence partner blurbs by EOD tomorrow. legal asked for a draft co-announcement copy before Feb 3.

ben_eng: tech checklist I'm adding to the repo: `repo/partner-sandbox/acceptance.md`. example tests: 
```
- ingest: csv -> vectorstore (LlamaIndex)
- chain: query -> retriever -> langchain agent -> tool call via gateway
- streaming: client receives streaming tokens
- fallback: route to smaller model when qps spike
```

ben_eng: I'll open PR with a small sample app using the Redwood SDK and LangChain integration.

alex_k: product asks for metrics we can show on the console: token cost, p95 latency, cache hit-rate, rollout success. ben, can you wire basic telemetry?

ben_eng: yes, pushing traces + simple dashboard panels. will mock data for demo.

jim_sre: SSO for partner engineers — do we have SAML set up for sandbox?

sophia_partner: we can use OAuth for now, partners prefer quick access. SAML is fine for later.

alex_k: decision: OAuth for the sprint. add a one-time invite token for partners.

maria_pm: announcement plan: internal preview Feb 6, partner dry-run Feb 10, public blog Feb 15. embargo until Feb 15.

marketing_anna: noted. will prep assets and a pinned demo script in the workspace.

integrations-bot: reminder set: `@channel` dry-run demo on 2101235600 (Feb 10 10:00 UTC).

alex_k: action items: 
- ben -> acceptance tests + sample app (due Feb 1)
- jim -> infra + quotas + OAuth invites (due Feb 3)
- sophia -> partner assets + legal copy (due Feb 3)
- anna -> marketing assets + landing + demo script (due Feb 5)
- maria -> runbook + announcement timeline (due Feb 4)

ben_eng: got it. will add test harness and a short `curl` example for onboarding:
```
curl -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.dev/v1/run \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
 -d '{"model":"open-llama-7b","input":"summarize..."}'
```

alex_k: quick Q: any blocker from marketplace team for listing? legal / billing entitlements?

marketing_anna: marketplace listing requires a short product description + pricing tier and a partner contact. we'll collect those in the workspace.

sophia_partner: partner-side contact is me. pricing TBD — partners are fine with a preview waiver for the demo.

maria_pm: adding QA session Feb 9. invite partner engineering leads.

jim_sre: I'll seed the sandbox with a small dataset and a sample LlamaIndex index.

ben_eng: final ask — can we get a small set of replay prompts (10-20) to show quality and regression checks? Sophia / partners can you provide them?

sophia_partner: yes, will collect 20 prompts across retrieval / agent / tool flows.

alex_k: perfect. keeping this thread as the coordination hub. ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:

marketing_anna: confirmed — I'll post the landing mock tomorrow and tag everyone. :eyes:

integrations-bot: pinned `repo/partner-sandbox/acceptance.md` to workspace.

ben_eng: logging off for today, will PR tomorrow morning.

maria_pm: thanks all.

alex_k: thanks — closing prep sync.
